beats.text: Central African Republic has 16 percent young boys. In Japan, it is 4 percent.
Central African Republic is the world's highest. Almost 1 in 6 males there is a child.
It has 2.8 times the share of the USA, which has 5.8 percent.
This counts the male population between the ages 5 to 9 as a percentage of all males.
The lowest shares on Earth? Japan and Italy at 4 percent, and South Korea at 3.5 percent.
Somalia has 15.7 percent and DR Congo has 15.4 percent.
Do you see many young boys in your city?
